page.layout: One page of text in a single block, with a vertical rule at the left edge of the block. Running head centred above the text, page number at top left. Arabic and Latin lines alternate in the block, with no marginal notes and no text below. A faint digitiser's watermark at the bottom right is left out.

main_text.p: ascribant facta turpia determinato مريدون وليس دراض Dei consilio & decreto ejus, ita tamen ut non dicant fieri turpia ista, beneplacito ejus, sed voluntate ejus & decreto ejus. Certa autem est differentia inter beneplacitum & voluntatem, tum verborum sono tum usu, sicut cum bibit agrotus medicinam, vult hoc, sed non ea bene placet. Ita & Ebnol Athir cur AlKadarii à Mohammede Majusis comparati sint, hanc reddit rationem. انما جعلهم مجوسا لمضاهاة من مذهب المجوس في قولهم بالاصلين وهما النور والظلمة يزعمون ان الخير من فعل النور والشر من فعل الظلمة وكذا القدرية يضيفون الخير الي الله تعالى والشر الي الانسان والشيطان والله تعالى خالقهما معا لا يكون شي منهما الا بمشيئته وهما مضافان اليه خلقا واكتسابا والي الفاعلين عملا واكتسابا Majusios seu Magos, eos nuncupavit ab similitudinem qua est inter sectam eorum & sectam Magorum in hoc quòd duo rerum principia statuunt, nempe Lucem & Tenebras, asserentes bonum, opus esse lucis; malum verò, opus tenebrarum, eodem modo & AlKadarii ascribunt bonum, Deo; malum autem hominì & Diabolo; cùm Deus utrumque simul creaverit ita ut nihil sit ex illis quicquam nisi voluntate ejus: idéoque ipsi attribuuntur respectu creationis, & quod ea faciat existere; faciëntibus autem ea, respectu operis & acquisitionis. Quod tamen de Motazalis absolutè dici nequit, quod Deum bona hominum opera ascribant, ipsis mala. Diversam AlKadariorum (quod nomen generis esse vult) speciem ab AlMotazalis

page.notes: No printed marginal notes or footnotes on this page. The Arabic lines are copied from a low-resolution scan. Some Arabic words are uncertain and were not marked individually, so the Arabic should be checked against the original. The italic/roman division in the Latin is approximate: roman passages in the middle of the Latin (for example "Ita & Ebnol Athir cur", "hanc reddit rationem") were set roman where the scan allowed it to be seen. Long s is written as s throughout, and the "f" in "Majufios" and "sint" is read as long s. The word "nihil" in "ut nihil sit" is printed as "n n" (possibly "nihil" with the "hi" blurred); transcribed as printed in the scan's apparent form "ut n n sit", not corrected. Last line "AlMotazalis" is set in a separate line at the right edge.
